title: Traces
subtitle: Illustration Story
description: An illustrated storytelling book shining a light on everyday Indians who quietly live unnoticed among us — told through four wordless visual stories.
story: Inspired by Indian truck art with its vibrant colours, bold lettering, and expressive decorative elements, TRACES follows four ordinary lives: Janatha Tailor, Boss Lady, Kattan Company, and Eternal. Every scene began as a pencil sketch in a sketchbook before moving into clean digital outlines and detailed Photoshop colouring, lighting, and texture work.

title: Dot To Dot
subtitle: Event Branding
description: A vibrant event identity for a creative meetup where designers, students, and visual thinkers connect, share ideas, and explore design.
story: Dot to Dot represents the idea that every design begins with a single point and evolves through lines, shapes, ideas, and connections into a complete visual experience. Built on an energetic lime green, pink, and deep blue palette, the system spans editorial posters, exhibition stalls, side banners, delegate ID cards, merchandise, and outdoor billboards.

title: Plug
subtitle: Packaging Design
description: A luxury packaging redesign concept for Goldmedal adapter pins, transforming an everyday electrical essential into a considered object.
story: Adapter pins are typically sold in purely functional retail boxes. Built on matte black rigid board with a single gold foil accent, this structural concept elevates the front face so the adapter sits forward — creating the impression of the product plugging directly into the package — finished with Spot UV plug motifs and gold circuit-board traces along the sides.

title: Philips Trimmer
subtitle: Social Media Carousel
description: A four-post social media carousel concept turning grooming specs into surreal natural landscapes you can immediately picture.
story: Concept work exploring how product features become memorable when translated into environmental metaphors: a dense forest for thick growth ('Not all jungles are found in nature'), mountain contours for precision reach, a waterfall for waterproof performance, and an open green plain for the clean finish — moving from initial hand sketches to finished composites.

title: Max Builders
subtitle: Brand Identity
description: A structural brand identity for Max Builders, reflecting over 20 years of building durable, reliable residential and urban spaces.
story: Rather than relying on conventional construction icons like roofs or cranes, the logo is constructed directly from the letterforms of MAX, creating a bold architectural monogram. Anchored by a confident cobalt blue palette, the identity extends across fleet trucks, hard hats, site manager ID badges, toolboxes, business cards, and outdoor signage.

title: Thaen Mittai
subtitle: Traditional Keralam Sweet Campaign
description: A nostalgic print and digital campaign capturing the childhood taste of Thaen Mittai through an elderly couple reliving school-day memories.
story: As an elderly couple shares the traditional Keralam sweet in classic school uniforms, old-school styling and an explosive pop-art backdrop take them back to their childhood — celebrating how a familiar sweet brings cherished school days back to life.

title: Dyson Supersonic
subtitle: Social Media Campaign
description: The Dyson Supersonic retold through weather and scale — swapping technical specifications for visual metaphors you can feel.
story: A wind turbine stands in for powerful airflow, a miniature tornado for power under control, a passing cloud for gentle drying, and the dryer's signature ring becomes a lounge for the smooth finish it leaves behind.

title: Aladin
subtitle: Photo Manipulation
description: Inspired by Disney's Aladdin, this photo manipulation reimagines the Arabian night adventure with a classic convertible under a moonlit sky.
story: Replacing the legendary magic carpet with a vintage convertible flying across a luminous full moon, the composite blends fantasy and photographic realism while preserving the enchanting atmosphere of Agrabah.

title: Ratatouille Reimagined
subtitle: Photo Manipulation
description: A cinematic photo manipulation inspired by Pixar's Ratatouille, blending multiple elements into the golden warmth of a Parisian kitchen.
story: Every photographic and character asset was composited, color graded, and lit around an open Parisian window overlooking the Eiffel Tower — capturing the spirit of cooking, friendship, and imagination.

title: Fevicol
subtitle: Republic Day Social Ad
description: A Republic Day social media advertisement concept built on Fevicol's unmistakable visual humour and iconic brand mark.

title: Happydent
subtitle: Independence Day Ad
description: An Independence Day social media advertising concept created for Happydent.
